Description
Amerigo Los Angeles Middle School sets students up for success at a rigorous American high school and beyond. Students have access to a curriculum specially designed to meet the specific needs of each individual student. They also have the chance to begin building their leadership skills outside of the classroom, through a wide array of extracurricular clubs, activities and competitive sports teams.
